currentWork.title: Real-device highway-selection mismatch remains after FINAL.44
currentWork.releaseStatus: User field confirmation says the recent UI/navigation changes are basically OK. The remaining concrete defect is that, with highway ON, VENDRIVE still sometimes stays off the expressway on a route where Google Maps uses the expressway.

validationEvidence.userFieldEvidence: 2026-10-08: 基本全部OK。ただしGoogleマップなら高速案内するところをVENDRIVEでは高速案内しない。
validationEvidence.currentUiExposure: These diagnostics are returned by /api/route but are not currently exposed in the UI.

decision: Treat the highway mismatch as new real-device field evidence, not as proof that FINAL.40 solved route selection.
Do not blindly widen FINAL.36 final detour caps or weaken HGV restrictions.

Before changing route thresholds, identify whether the failing case is caused by ORS not returning a motorway option, IC search not producing a usable candidate, or final bounded acceptance rejecting the candidate.
Preserve driving-hgv, exact vehicle restrictions, max two active via-IC probes, warm 30 route calls/min guard, and no passenger-car/straight-line fallback.
nextActions: Capture the highway-search diagnostics for the exact failing real-device route without exposing unnecessary location details.
Use those diagnostics to classify the failure as provider-candidate, IC-discovery, via-timeout, or final-eligibility rejection.
Only then open a bounded production-code fix with a new immutable safety tag.

requiredUserInput: One reproduction of the highway mismatch after diagnostics are made accessible, or the exact failing origin/destination only if diagnostics alone are insufficient.
unresolved: Highway ON still fails to select an expressway on at least one real-device route where Google Maps does.
